The '''''Opos''''' was a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 transport]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The freighter attempted to dock with the [[XQ4 Platform]] [[Enin'sd]], but it was destroyed in the process by [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
